comment: The distortion path and the drum path are independent except that both run through distort(); DIST-IN never reaches DRUM-OUT and the envelopes never touch DIST-OUT. ENV(S) is 5*(freq-basefreq)/(peakfreq-basefreq): HIGH has a minimum of 100Hz and LOW a maximum of 100Hz, so the denominator can be made exactly zero from the panel. The wavefolder's inner reflection loop runs at most three times per pass, so a very high FOLD setting can leave a sample outside ±1 going into the clipper, where it is flattened.
